node.statement: Hermitian projection control. Star preservation gives R_a^dagger=R_a. In M_r, E_aa^2=E_aa and ||E_aa||=1. Delta-multiplicativity of v into the compressed algebra gives ||R_a dot R_a-R_a||<=delta, while the registered compressed-product estimate gives ||R_a dot R_a-R_a^2||<=c_1*e||R_a||^2. The norm bound ||R_a||<=1+delta therefore yields ||R_a^2-R_a||<=C_1*e with universal C_1, uniformly in a and r.
